dividends: excluded for every arm: payment dates and per-share adjusted basis unverified; price-return only
limitations: Retrospective survivor universe, not historical membership; no alpha/OOS/certification claim
No independent vendor receipts or as-of publication timestamps; present-day split adjustment may restate history
No sector/earnings/PIT labels or synthetic predictor imported
Missing bar cancels next-open order; held shares marked last observed close and logged; no fabricated fills
No terminal liquidation; final NAV marked close; fractional shares; no taxes/borrow/market impact calibration
Volume gate is current share volume divided by trailing 20-session mean > 0.25; no absolute adjusted-price or dollar-volume threshold; missing volume blocks entries
Equal-weight buy-hold allocates initial capital/79 after first observed close for each ticker; delayed listings retain reserved cash
Risk constraints are sizing/scenario controls, not guarantees; price gaps may breach exposure limits
